name: SuperCDMS Soudan
notes: This experiment (INSPIRE recid 1298909, FNAL-E-0891) is the Soudan-era SuperCDMS programme, which has an explicit completion date (2015-01-01) independently confirmed by Symmetry Magazine; the later SNOLAB programme is recorded separately as experiment:supercdms.

summary.plain: The first-generation SuperCDMS dark matter detector, which ran in the Soudan mine in Minnesota from about 2009 until 2015, using an improved version of the CDMS II crystal detectors before the experiment moved to a larger site in Canada.
summary.technical: SuperCDMS Soudan (INSPIRE FNAL-E-0891, recid 1298909): first-generation SuperCDMS programme at the Soudan Underground Laboratory, 2009-2015, using iZIP (interleaved Z-sensitive Ionization and Phonon) cryogenic Ge/Si detectors -- an evolution of the CDMS-II detector design with substantially improved surface-event background rejection. Superseded by SuperCDMS SNOLAB (experiment:supercdms).
